A '''clone trooper''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], participating in a [[Battle of Gwori|mission]] to the [[Gwori shipyards]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Unidentified Gwori lizard|lizard]] in a cave.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />
